text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Mr. C.B. is moving up! Mr. C.B. is making 
her move!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: So you've come, C.B....!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Ngh, gah!? —What incredible pressure! My 
legs feel like they're grinding to a 
halt...!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (Still――!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (My—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (Everything up until now——!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I believe!!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Give it everything! Every, every, last 
bit of it!!! Let out everything I've 
worked for up until now!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Katsuragi Ace!! Here comes Katsuragi Ace!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...! Haha!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Katsuragi Ace crosses the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa...!! ...Ngh, I... I won, 
didn't I...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yes... Yes, alright, yes!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ALLLLLLRIIIIIIIIGHTTTTTTTT!!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Friend
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaay!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, totally incredible, Ess-chi!! You 
actually won the Derby...!! This is 
insane...!! I'm gonna cry...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: Ace-chan...! Congratulations...!!

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Seriouslyyy...? Wait, what? C.B.... Are 
you serious...?

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan B
text_block_list.text:
“No way... I was certain she'd become a 
Derby Umamusume...—”

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Ace.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Aaargh, that's so frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Still, even more than that— it was 
incredibly passionate.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
All that's left now is the Kikuka Sho. 
I'll be taking my revenge for today.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on...!! I'm gonna win next time 
too!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Nice. ——I'm getting fired up.

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...It's no use. There's no way I can 
compete with that—

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: "...Ace-san. Why are you so...—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
We did it, we did itttt!! We actually did 
itttt!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace leaps toward me with all the 
momentum from her sprint.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I won—!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, putting our arms around each 
other's shoulders, we excitedly shared our 
joy. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as the initial wave of celebration 
settled, I noticed the surrounding crowd 
was unusually quiet—hardly the reception 
you'd expect for a victor.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Honestly, I really wanted to 
celebrate Mr. C.B.'s victory right here...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Turmoil, huh...? To be honest, I really 
didn't want to see any today...—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Sheesh, even Derby-winning Umamusume 
are just stepping stones for CB, huh—
choice_data_list: Even so, let's hold our heads high.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: Ace-chaaaan!!! Congraaaatuuulaaations!!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: You were sooooo freaking cool—!!
choice_data_list: …To answer those who were watching you

...To live up to the expectations of those 
who were watching you.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you're right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap clap clap—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Someday, without a doubt... I'll make 
everyone here acknowledge me, no questions 
asked!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Who is the winner, and who is the true 
'Ace'!!)

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
"—Katsuragi Ace has seized the victory, 
but how will she fare in the Kikuka Sho, 
one wonders?"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Over long distances, it will indeed come 
down to a fight between Mr. C.B. and 
Shiina Frejus. Those two seem better 
suited for it. Furthermore--"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"It feels like CB's running has grown 
stronger and stronger through the Satsuki 
Sho and the Derby. We're eager to see if 
she can get her revenge—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(......The Kikuka Sho's distance makes it 
a brutally tough race for me. Like I care, 
though...!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd chicken out over distance at this 
point...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: All right! 10 more reps!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After giving Katsuragi Ace instructions 
for independent training, I was rushing 
around the academy handling paperwork and 
research when—

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—So, you're really giving up on aiming for 
the Kikuka Sho, then?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing a conversation carried with tense 
undertones from just ahead, I 
instinctively stop in my tracks.

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I'm already... at my limit...

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Competing against CB-san... and being 
compared to CB-san...!

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I can't take it anymore...! I'm so sorry, 
Trainer...—

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. There's no need to 
apologize. Let's figure out what to do 
next together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...To avoid eavesdropping any further, I 
silently turned on my heel. And what 
welled up inside my heart was—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The final battle of the Triple Crown, the 
'Kikuka Sho.' Before and after it, my 
desire was to stay by Katsuragi Ace's side 
and continue supporting her heart."
